rapport_notes: Friendly and thankful throughout, handled the auto-booking mixup and the last-minute TV disclosure with warmth.

evidence_quotes.agenda: No quid pro quo or agenda question was asked; the call went straight into confirming an existing online auto-booking.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: I do have a... very large and very thin TV that requires a little special attention -> rep only asked for the size, no further follow-up.

top_strength: Warm, thorough confirmation of booking details and inventory, catching and correcting a date mixup between the online auto-booking and the phone request.
coaching_note: This was really a booking-confirmation call, not a sales discovery call -- no agenda question, no differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover), and no Save Your Ass lines were used at all.
